# `company.bulk_edit_rows`

The diff of a grid edit, one row per record changed or refused, with its outcome written once at apply. Never deleted.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `run_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1 | — | bulk_edit_runs.id | The grid edit. |
| `seq` | INTEGER | no | — | primary key 2 | — | — | Position of the record in the selection, from 1. |
| `record_type` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | ix_bulk_edit_rows_record | — | Record type (customer, vendor, item, account). |
| `record_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_bulk_edit_rows_record | — | The record. |
| `label` | VARCHAR(1004) | no | — | — | — | — | Its full name when previewed. |

| `status` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | change (the update dry-ran clean) or refused (it did not). |
| `changes` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON list of field, before and after (input-shaped), and each as shown. |
| `code` | VARCHAR(64) | yes | — | — | — | — | Stable code of a refusal at preview; null otherwise. |

| `merged_over` | TEXT | yes | — | — | — | — | JSON list of the versions an apply merged over; null when none. |
| `event_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | audit_events.id | Audit event of the update; null when it did not run. |
